title: Завдання та план оцифрування
fields_and_relations: План revision, частини/порядок, профіль, ризики й readiness.
required_interaction: Ready/postpone; змінений план не підмінює план старого capture/QC.

implementation.view_model: List → versioned plan wizard → carrier identification, condition evidence, typed profile, temporary custody and explicit readiness/postponement → WF-11. Every capture rechecks exact preparation.
limitations: Human physical inspection and custody confirmation; no hardware integration.
100 plan rows, 100 outputs per row, 500 total; one capture kind per plan.
WF-11 still produces explicitly labelled text examples; no claim of real digitization.
implementation.state_storage: Normalized browser store v9; preserves existing user data. Older unstructured preparations require explicit review.
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
implementation.digitization: WF-11: binary files or browser camera/microphone; ordered composite plan mapping; explicit provenance, deviations and recapture; immutable originals and downloadable manifest/files.
implementation.quality_handoff: WF-12: exact representation QC, recalculated checksums, parameter comparisons and per-file evidence; known-defect acceptance or explicit recapture; linked issue resolution only after acceptance.
